statement: virtualgamepad's optional installed rules grant dedicated trusted groups mode 0660 on /dev/uhid and /dev/uinput for device creation; separate input/hidraw nodes still follow their own udev ACL and seat policies.

applicability.revision: public Steam rules 22ec85e, systemd ede1e57, kernel 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b or virtualgamepad 8f60dcc; host not inspected
applicability.scope: virtualgamepad udev/70-virtualgamepad-{uhid,uinput}.rules lines 1-2; installing grants is an administrator opt-in and cannot be inferred from repo files.
